observations: Exact visible ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS; each frame includes full native key history and visible status flags. Initial settings in metadata are normalized by those key sequences.

Ratio, polynomial Equation and Inequality result presentation resets after applying a setting. Cancelling the settings menu preserves the presentation. Equation decimal roots honor Fix; the Inequality decimal endpoint table uses ten significant digits independently of Fix/Sci.
Complex result answers remain as displayed while settings change. Matrix, Vector and Distribution input/result settings samples are included.

SETTINGS is ignored on Statistics result screens. Subsequent AC returns to the data grid at its first cell. Settings are available on that grid; cells retain compact values while the footer and FIX/SCI flags follow the current setting.
Statistics data-grid up/down wraps through the populated rows and the next blank row. Fraction and decimal values were measured under Norm, Fix and Sci.

Probability result presentation resets to the configured output style after settings. LineI/LineO can retain the exact line fraction. Ratio decimal comma retains the numeric baseline including the descending comma glyph.
